ruleset: Generation IX core; Scarlet/Violet level-up learnsets, BDSP fallback for unavailable species Pidgey/Caterpie

moves.name: Tackle
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Growl
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

moves.name: Growth
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.
moves.description: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.effect: Seeds the target, stealing HP from it every turn.
moves.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.effect: Poisons the target.
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.effect: Puts the target to sleep.
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.
moves.description: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Ember
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

moves.name: Slash
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.name: Inferno
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.  Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.effect: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.
moves.description: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Bite
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Protect
moves.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.effect: Raises user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages.  Lower user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.effect: Confuses the target.
moves.description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

moves.name: Charm
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Play Nice
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.description: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.effect: Paralyzes the target.
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.effect: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.effect: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Feint
moves.effect: Hits through Protect and Detect.
moves.description: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.

moves.name: Spark
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Agility
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.effect: Reduces damage from special attacks by 50% for five turns.
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.description: Sand is hurled in the target's face, lowering the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Gust
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Pokémon in the air.
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Twister
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
moves.description: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

moves.name: Roost
moves.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.effect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.effect: Never misses.
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.description: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.effect: Ally’s next move inflicts half more damage.
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Covet
moves.effect: Takes the target’s item.
moves.description: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Swift
moves.effect: Never misses.
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.effect: Uses the target’s last used move.
moves.description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.effect: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.effect: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.effect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
moves.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.effect: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
moves.description: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.effect: User faints.
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.effect: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.effect: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.effect: User faints.
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.effect: Confuses the target.
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Lick
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.effect: Puts the target to sleep.
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

moves.name: Mean Look
moves.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
moves.description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

moves.name: Payback
moves.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
moves.description: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.

moves.name: Spite
moves.effect: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Curse
moves.effect: Ghosts pay half their max HP to hurt the target every turn.  Others decrease Speed but raise Attack and Defense.
moves.description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

moves.name: Hex
moves.effect: Has double power if the target has a major status ailment.
moves.description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
moves.description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.effect: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
moves.description: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.effect: Only works on sleeping Pokémon.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Acid
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.effect: Paralyzes the target.
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.effect: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.effect: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power.
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
moves.description: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.effect: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.description: The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Disable
moves.effect: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.
moves.description: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Screech
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Soak
moves.effect: Changes the target’s type to Water.
moves.description: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.effect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.effect: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.description: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.name: Leer
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.effect: Ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.description: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Slam
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.effect: Protects the user’s field from major status ailments and confusion for five turns.
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
moves.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Howl
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
moves.description: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.  Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.
moves.description: The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.effect: Has double power if a friendly Pokémon fainted last turn.
moves.description: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Roar
moves.effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Incinerate
moves.effect: Destroys the target’s held berry.
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.effect: Burns the target.
moves.description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.effect: Prevents the target from using any moves that the user also knows.
moves.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.description: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Charge
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage.  User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.
moves.description: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Peck
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.description: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Haze
moves.effect: Resets all Pokémon’s stats, accuracy, and evasion.
moves.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.effect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.effect: Calculates damage with the target’s attacking stat.
moves.description: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.

moves.name: Torment
moves.effect: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.
moves.description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: Quash
moves.effect: Makes the target act last this turn.
moves.description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

moves.name: Flail
moves.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Endure
moves.effect: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sing
moves.effect: Puts the target to sleep.
moves.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Mist
moves.effect: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.
moves.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
moves.description: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Brine
moves.effect: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.effect: User and target both faint after three turns.
moves.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.effect: Causes a one-hit KO.
moves.description: The target faints instantly. This move is less likely to hit the target if used by Pokémon other than Ice types.
